cbdc_intro_1: Dziko lathu likukhala ladigitala kwambiri, momwemonso ndalama zathu.
cbdc_intro_2: Izi zimafunsa funso: tikufuna ndalama zathu zadigitala zikhale zotani?
cbdc_intro_3: Mayiko ambiri akufufuza kutulutsa Ndalama Zadigitala za Banki ya Boma (CBDC) yomwe ndi ndalama zadigitala kwathunthu za ndalama zathu za boma zilipo.
cbdc_intro_4: Tiyeni tione kusiyana pakati pa mitundu iwiri ya ndalama zadigitala: Bitcoin ndi Ndalama Zadigitala za Banki ya Boma (Ma CBDC).
bitcoin_point_6: Ogwiritsa ntchito amatha kuthamanga ma node
point_1_summary_1: Palibe amene angakuletse kuti mugwiritse ntchito Bitcoin. Ma CBDC adapangidwa kuti maboma ndi mabanki apakatikati athe kulamulira malipiro aliwonse, kuchepetsa chinsinsi ndi ufulu wanu.
point_1_summary_2: Palibe amene angakuletseni kuchita malonda ndi Bitcoin.
point_1_summary_3: Ma CBDC apangidwa kupereka ulamuliro wathunthu kwa maboma ndi mabanki a boma pa ndalama zanu.
point_2_summary_1: Bitcoin sithetsa ndipo ilibe ndalama za mwezi uliwonse. Ma CBDC akhoza kupangidwa kuti athetse, kuletsa inu kusunga m'tsogolo.
point_2_summary_3: Ma CBDC akathera, amakuletsani kusunga ndalama kwa tsogolo.
point_3_summary_1: Bitcoin ili ndi malire akhwawakhwa a 21 miliyoni ya BTC. Ma CBDC alibe malire a kuchuluka, kulola maboma kukulitsa ndalama malingana ndi kufuna kwawo — zomwe zimapangitsa
point_4_summary_1: Maadilesi a Bitcoin samalumikizidwa ndi dzina lanu lenileni. Ma CBDC amalumikizana mwachindunji ndi ID ya boma, kulola kufunafuna ndalama kwakukulu komanso kuletsa.
point_5_summary_1: Malamulo a Bitcoin amatsimikiziridwa ndi makumi ambiri a node odziimira okha. Ma CBDC ali pakatikati m'manja mwa boma ndi mabanki apakatikati, omwe ali ndi mphamvu zonse pa netiweki.
point_5_summary_2: Zikwi makumi a ma node odziimira okha amatsimikizira malamulo a netiwekiyo.
point_6_summary_1: Aliyense akhoza kuyendetsa node ya Bitcoin kuti atsimikizire malamulo a netiweki. Ma CBDC sasalola ogwiritsa ntchito kuyendetsa ma node — muyenera kudalira ulamuliro wapakatikati.
point_7_summary_1: Bitcoin yosungidwa nokha singatsekedwe ndi aliyense. Ma CBDC adapangidwa kuti maboma ndi mabanki apakatikati athe kutseka akaunti pomwepo.
point_8_summary_1: Bitcoin imakupatsani mphamvu yonse pa ndalama zanu mukasunga nokha ndi
point_8_summary_3: Ma CBDC amafunika kudalira osungira monga mabanki kapena maboma kuti asunge ndalama zanu.
point_9_summary_1: Lamulo la ndalama la Bitcoin lakhazikika mu khodi ndipo silingasinthe. Ma CBDC akhoza kupangidwanso malingana ndi kufuna kwa andale, zomwe zimapangitsa
point_10_summary_1: Bitcoin ndi netiweki ya makompyuta yotetezedwa kwambiri yomwe inamangidwapo ndipo sinathaweko. Ma CBDC amadalira mabanki ndi maboma omwe athawapo nthawi zambiri.
hero_title: Kusiyana pakati pa Bitcoin ndi CBDC
